A WORKING BEGINNING

The calendar comes first.

SHOWS is a provisional name for a curated Portland discovery project. This working version explores date and place browsing, event details, saving locally, and Google / Apple calendar export. Inclusion is not endorsement. Original organizers get the credit.

No sign-in, analytics, behavioral tracking, or user profiles. Saved events are stored only in this browser. Calendar and map links open external services only when you choose them.

Event times are shown in Portland's Pacific Time zone. Published details can change. Sample checked October 17, 2026.
